AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Pollution.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Pollution.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Pollution.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Trees.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Trees.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Trees.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Selected Crop Management Practises? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Selected Crop Management Practises.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Selected Crop Management Practises.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Selected Crop Management Practises.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Selected Crop Management Practises.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Constructing Water Retention Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Constructing Water Retention Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Food Nutrients and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Trees and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Establishment Planting Site and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Crop Management Practises and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
